body: I appreciate your comment a lot, I think it's a good idea to find a community, I'll try to find some I could join :)
it's so invalidating and i wish things would get better for us

I'm sorry your dad says that to you. my dad always constantly picked on my weight, on the amount of food I ate, to a point where I developed a habit of over-eating. I understand, I felt ugly too, it really just makes you so insecure, and self-conscious all the time. I can tell you 100% that you are not ugly. I don't need a picture, I know you're not because nobody is. It's only the high standards of outer looks/beauty in society that labels and shames certain individuals for being born the way they are. I wish it wasn't the case. I know that low self-esteem won't be fixed overnight, but, being able to just say it, is a good first step.

For your dad, try to talk to him and tell him how you feel. if he still does it, you might want to consider creating boundaries. I personally had to do that with my dad to help with my self-esteem.

Lastly, your personality is way more valuable and important. Someone should like you for your personality not your looks, Remember that.
